_comment: Global Simulator Buy: the 20 VilfinTV agents (persons in sim_config.json) each run one simulated US-listed ETF account that buys the Portfolio Simulator — Global ETF 10+ year model portfolio (plan h15<risk>) from the start date. Very aggressive agents follow the aggressive plan (the global simulator has three risk levels). Amounts are in US dollars after conversion; currency conversion and remittance costs are not modelled.

fractional._note: fractional shares in steps of 0.0001; an order under $1 waits for the slot's next buy

fees._note: commission per order: $0.0035 a share, at least $0.35, at most 1% of the trade value; exchange and clearing fees on buys (fractions of a cent) are not modelled

withholding._note: US tax withheld on dividends: India residents 25% under the India–US treaty (Form W-8BEN); the four US-based team members are US tax residents (Form W-9), so nothing is withheld at source
